description: A highly personalized infinite canvas whiteboard custom-built with Conjure OS. Designed for specialized workflows and general use, featuring unlimited resizable floating viewports, innovative top-edge text box drag-insertion with automatic zoom scaling, stylus pen tilt-activated tools (eraser, highlighter, and colors), automatic Magic Canvas folder imports with customized quality and spacing, and direct document integration with the Lesson Planner API.
